node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 dihedral outer-factor reduction
node.closure: elliptic involution quotient, two-degree projection dihedral theorem, and exact six-pole ramification sieve
node.statement: In the full-V4 (m,r,delta)=(2,2,4) row, the outer bidegree-(2,2) component is rational even when the source normalization is elliptic. Its two degree-two projections generate a finite dihedral group, so the outer degree-30 map has a geometric Dickson/Chebyshev right factor. The six distinct order-five poles restrict its degree to n=2,3,5,6. The source-to-outer V4 cover has branch inertia a,c,ac in source genus zero and c,c,ac,ac in source genus one. No surviving factor degree, owner charge, or prize row is closed.
